## Overview

Policy analysis of how the 2023 SAG-AFTRA contract governs AI and digital replicas. Using BLS QCEW employment data, it documents Los Angeles's post-strike employment collapse in the motion picture industry, applies Stigler's theory of regulatory capture to the contract negotiations, and argues that collective bargaining alone is structurally insufficient as an AI governance mechanism: a federal statutory baseline is needed.
